name: transcribe
description: Aligns audio speech segments with transcripts, validates standardized handoff schemas, and aggregates multi-source findings. Compatible with skill: 'multi-source-worker' (.agents/skills/multi-source-worker/SKILL.md) for multi-stream isolation and disparate clocks. Simple single-stream transcription runs directly without requiring skill loading. All file paths must resolve inside the workspace root; secret files (.env, *.pem, *.key) are rejected.

mode.description: Operational mode: 'align' for segment alignment, 'export_handoff' to produce a standardized handoff JSON, 'validate_handoff' to verify fail-closed schema compliance, or 'aggregate' to merge multiple source handoffs.

input.description: Workspace-relative path to the raw speech segments JSON file containing timestamps and text.

transcript.description: Workspace-relative path to the plain text transcript file for sentence-by-sentence alignment.

sourceId.description: Identifier for the source stream (e.g., 'video', 'audio'). Required when mode is export_handoff.

originFile.description: Original media filename (e.g., 'status-line.mp3'). Required when mode is export_handoff.

clockRef.description: Clock reference identifier conforming to UTC or local±Nh. Required when mode is export_handoff.

clockOffset.description: Integer hour offset relative to UTC (e.g. +2 for local+2h). Required when mode is export_handoff.

handoff.description: Workspace-relative path to the handoff JSON file when mode is 'validate_handoff' or 'export_handoff'.

handoffs.description: List of workspace-relative handoff file paths to combine when mode is 'aggregate'.

output.description: Target workspace-relative output file path to write results.
